exposure: getting out of bed within 2 days after delivery
outcome: Postpartum diseases (prolonged lochia, backache, constipation, insufficient milk secretion, breast swelling, hemorrhoids)
cohort: 2013 puerperal women in urban and suburban Guangzhou, China
finding: Several traditional Chinese postpartum dietary and behavioral practices are associated with maternal health outcomes during the puerperium.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of at least one postpartum health problem or weight retention.
